name: Spectral Opera
disable: DC 46 Performance check (master) to disrupt the song with another tune, or DC 43 Religion check (expert) to calm the spirits

items.name: Haunting Melody
items.text:
Trigger A nonworshipper of Norgorber enters the room

---
Effect The tormented spirits rise, and their chorus deals 6d12+33 mental damage to any within the room who don't worship Norgorber. Affected creatures must each attempt a DC 37 Will save save.

---
Critical Success The creature is unharmed.

Success The creature takes half damage and is Frightened 1.

Failure The creature takes full damage and is Frightened 2.

Critical Failure The creature takes double damage. It becomes Frightened 3 and Fleeing for 1 round.

text: A spectral cast of singers in opera costumes emerges from the walls, keening a mournful and terrifying chorus.
